description: Ensure a git clone exists at repo_path and matches origin's state. Existing matching clones are fetched and reset (much faster than re-cloning); mismatched paths are replaced when clear is true.

git_url.description: URL of the git repository to clone

repo_path.description: Path where the clone should exist

branch.description: Branch to check out (reset to origin's tip)

clear.description: When repo_path exists but is not a clone of git_url: true replaces it, false fails (default: true)
